name: file
summary: Read, create, edit, and patch workspace files (text, images, and video).

subcommands.name: read
subcommands.summary: Read a file. Text files print as text; image and video files are shown to you as viewable media. Output is the raw file bytes, so it also pipes cleanly into other commands (e.g. ffmpeg).
subcommands.successOutput: writes the raw file bytes to stdout; an image or video result is presented to you as viewable media
subcommands.failureOutput: writes the reason to stderr and exits non-zero if the path is missing or unreadable

input.description: `file.read`: writes the file's bytes to stdout.
input.title: ReadArgs

subcommands.name: create
subcommands.summary: Create a new file. Fails if the file exists.
subcommands.failureOutput: writes the reason to stderr and exits non-zero without overwriting existing files

input.description: `file.create`: creates a new file; an existing file is left as it is.
input.title: CreateArgs

subcommands.name: edit
subcommands.summary: Replace exact text in an existing file.
subcommands.failureOutput: writes no-match, ambiguous-match, or write errors to stderr and exits non-zero without partial writes

input.description: `file.edit`: replaces one occurrence of exact text in an existing file.

context.description: Line number used to choose the nearest occurrence

input.title: EditArgs

subcommands.name: patch
subcommands.summary: Apply a unified diff patch to one or more files.
subcommands.failureOutput: writes parse, validation, or write errors to stderr and exits non-zero after rolling back partial writes when possible

input.description: `file.patch`: applies a unified diff to one or more files.
input.title: PatchArgs
